meta.source: Sampled from the client logo file (Als_in_1_Logo.png), October 2026

tokens.name: surface-cream
tokens.usage: Page background. Sampled from the logo ground — the default canvas for web and social.

tokens.name: surface-paper
tokens.usage: Cards, forms and raised panels on surface-cream.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Alternating section background (e.g. Why Choose Us, FAQ) to break up long pages. Text tokens below pass on it.

tokens.name: surface-bark
tokens.usage: Dark blocks: footer, closing CTA band, social 'quote' posts. Pair only with on-bark text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on cream, sand and paper. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on cream, sand and paper (9.3:1 on cream). Sampled from the TUINDIENSTE line of the logo.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta on cream and paper (4.7:1 on cream). Only 4.3:1 on sand — use ink for small text on sand.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: PRIMARY brand colour — the tree trunks. Primary buttons, links, eyebrow labels, icons on cream (5.0:1 on cream). Text on a bark fill uses on-bark.

tokens.name: bark-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of bark buttons and links; also large headings when you want warmth instead of ink.

tokens.name: on-bark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bark, bark-deep and surface-bark fills (5.0:1 on bark, 7.9:1 on bark-deep).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Accent FILL only — the middle tree. Decorative discs, illustrations, social graphics. Fails as text on cream (2.4:1): never use for words.

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Light leaf tint for Grasperke chips and soft success backgrounds. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: leaf-deep
tokens.usage: Green that carries text: WhatsApp buttons, success messages, 'in season' tags (4.8:1 on cream; white text on it 5.3:1).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Accent FILL — the left tree. Highlight blocks, badges, social post backgrounds. Text on it is ink (5.2:1).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Accent FILL — the big tree. Use sparingly: one highlight per screen or post (a price burst, a 'Book now' sticker). Text on it is ink. Never text colour.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on ochre, sun and leaf-soft fills. Always ink, never white. On full leaf, keep text 18px bold or larger (3.8:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline only. One per page. Drop to 40px under 640px wide.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles on inner pages; mobile hero.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: ALL CAPS label above headings, echoing the logo's wide-tracked TUINDIENSTE. Colour: bark. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ons sny, kant af en hou jou beddings skoon — elke keer op die dag wat ons sê.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Weekliks of eenmalig — ons pas by jou tuin se behoeftes aan.
styles.usage: Default paragraph text. Never below 16px on mobile.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, list item leads.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, footer, form hints. Colour: ink-muted on cream or paper.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading-to-content within a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, images, social post corners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels, CTA band.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips — pill shape, echoing the round tree canopies.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card on cream.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Card hover, sticky mobile CTA.
